sections.heading: Plain-English takeaway
sections.body: Source detail (MarketWatch Top Stories): While SpaceX is due to join the Nasdaq-100 on Tuesday, it won’t become part of the S&P 500 for at least another year — likely furthering the volatility spread between those two indexes. The markets news matters because it changes the read on Deal Financing Window: investors have to decide whether the new fact improves growth durability, margin confidence, valuation support, or financing conditions. The deeper question is what the move says about what investors are willing to believe about future revenue, margins, and durability.

sections.heading: What moved and what it suggests
sections.body: The fresh fact changes sector leadership, company valuation, and the peer read-through. The tape read matters when leadership, breadth, and risk appetite point in the same direction rather than merely producing a one-day bounce. The bottom line is use the precedent to test whether demand turns into profit and cash flow.

sections.body: Watch follow-through in peer stocks, guidance, order/backlog commentary, and capital-markets activity. The point of this checklist is to separate a one-day stock reaction from evidence that the market's new interpretation is actually becoming durable.
